name: Phone P-009 D-022 call-content policy mutation guards (notice-before-capture, 30-day retention, content-free owner alerts, approval-gated audio storage)
command: bash .papercusp/scratch/p009-probes.sh && bash .papercusp/scratch/p009-probes-2.sh  # papercusp root; one iteration per entry in probes[] (round 1: first 8, round 2: deletion/tenant/persist)

scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file "$file" --relocation overlay --mutate "$mutate" --test "cd $PHONE_APP_ROOT/$dir && npx vitest run $tests"  # $file=probes[].subject, $tests=probes[].tests, mutation described in probes[].mutation
summary: 11/11 copy-out overlay mutants CAUGHT in two rounds (05:12:02-05:12:51Z D-022 rules; 05:24:34-05:25:28Z postgres persistence/deletion/tenant scope). Every probe ran an unmutated baseline and an unmutated relocated-copy baseline (both green: data call-content-policy 11/11, data call-deletion.integration 12/12, data voicemail-persistence.integration 5/5, sidecar api 78/78, worker agent-authority 67/67) before its mutant; each mutant produced >=1 targeted failure in phone-app's own Vitest. Covers the R-42 capture notice gate (pure rule, pre-notice speech filter, sidecar transcript/voicemail/summary refusal, notice timestamp bounds, worker reports the notice only after playout), R-43 30-day retention cutoff, R-46 owner-only content-free alerts, R-47 audio storage disabled unless the approving decision is named, R-45 authorized deletion erases voicemail content, R-84 tenant-scoped voicemail listing, and R-7/PHONE-P-009-OUTCOME stored voicemail transcript survives persistence. The sidecar and postgres-store probes also exercise the production paths named by R-12/R-74. Subject source is phone-app commit f23379183d7457d050541d1ae92c0d05554f3cf1 (clean at probe time). Not covered: live PSTN playout of the notice on a real call (D-020 Telnyx key absent) and deletion of content already mirrored into Portal agent-chat (tracked as WI-10006406). The driver script was an uncommitted scratch file; the per-probe subject, mutation, tests and counts are recorded below.

assertions.evidence: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts captureRefusal notice gate disabled: baseline 11/11, copy 11/11, mutant 1 failed | 10 passed
packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts segmentsAfterNotice keeps pre-notice speech: baseline 11/11, copy 11/11, mutant 1 failed | 10 passed
packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts resolveAudioStoragePolicy accepts any non-empty ref: baseline 11/11, copy 11/11, mutant 1 failed | 10 passed
packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts retentionCutoff = now: baseline 11/11, copy 11/11, mutant 1 failed | 10 passed
packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts buildCallAlerts leaks transcript: baseline 11/11, copy 11/11, mutant 1 failed | 10 passed
apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts ingestTranscript refuseCapture removed: baseline 78/78, copy 78/78, mutant 1 failed | 77 passed
apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts recordCaptureNotice startedAt lower bound removed: baseline 78/78, copy 78/78, mutant 1 failed | 77 passed
worker/src/agent.ts notice reported without awaiting playout: baseline 67/67, copy 67/67, mutant 1 failed | 66 passed
packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts deleteCallContent keeps phone_voicemails rows: baseline 12/12, copy 12/12, mutant 5 failed | 7 passed
packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts listVoicemails owner filter removed: baseline 5/5, copy 5/5, mutant 3 failed | 2 passed
packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts saveVoicemail stores an empty transcript: baseline 5/5, copy 5/5, mutant 2 failed | 3 passed

subjectRepository: phone-app harness repository (~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/phone-app, also reachable as ~/papercupai-workspace/phone-app); every probes[].subject/tests path is relative to that root.
method: papercusp scripts/mutation-probe.sh copy-out --relocation overlay: the mutant is bound over the real source path inside a private mount namespace, so the shared tree is never mutated. Each probe ran an unmutated baseline, an unmutated relocated-copy baseline, then the mutant, with phone-app's own Vitest. Tree integrity was verified byte-identical after every probe.
scope: Falsifiability of the D-022 call-content policy rules in packages/data, their sidecar enforcement in apps/sidecar (transcript/voicemail/summary refusal before the notice, notice timestamp bounds) and the worker's notice-after-playout reporting, plus the postgres store's content deletion, tenant-scoped voicemail listing and voicemail persistence. Real PSTN calls, carrier-side recording and Portal agent-chat mirror deletion are NOT covered.

probes.name: notice-rule
probes.subject: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts
probes.mutation: captureRefusal: `if (!call.captureNoticeAt) return "phone_capture_notice_required";` replaced by `if (false) ...` (capture allowed before the notice)
probes.failedTest: D-022 capture consent (R-42) > refuses every kind of capture before the notice has played

probes.name: after-notice
probes.subject: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts
probes.mutation: segmentsAfterNotice: `Number.isFinite(at) && at >= notice` replaced by `Number.isFinite(at)` (pre-notice speech kept)
probes.failedTest: D-022 capture consent (R-42) > keeps only speech from after the notice finished

probes.name: audio-ref
probes.subject: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts
probes.mutation: resolveAudioStoragePolicy: `ref === PHONE_CALL_CONTENT_POLICY.approvalRef` replaced by `ref.length > 0` (any reference enables audio storage)
probes.failedTest: D-022 consent-sensitive audio storage (R-47) > is disabled unless the approving decision is named

probes.name: retention
probes.subject: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts
probes.mutation: retentionCutoff: `now - retentionDays * DAY_MS` replaced by `now` (everything immediately purgeable)
probes.failedTest: D-022 retention (R-43) > puts the purge cutoff exactly 30 days before now

probes.name: alert-content
probes.subject: packages/data/src/call-content-policy.ts
probes.mutation: buildCallAlerts: `callerLabel: mail.callerLabel` replaced by `callerLabel: mail.transcript` (message content leaks into the alert)
probes.failedTest: D-022 owner-only, content-free alerts (R-46) > alerts on voicemail and missed inbound calls without content

probes.name: ledger-gate
probes.subject: apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts
probes.mutation: ingestTranscript: `this.refuseCapture(call, "transcript");` deleted (sidecar accepts transcript before the notice)
probes.failedTest: D-022 call-content policy > R-42: refuses transcript, voicemail and summary until the notice has played

probes.name: notice-bound
probes.subject: apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts
probes.mutation: recordCaptureNotice: the `|| at < Date.parse(call.startedAt)` lower bound removed (notice can be backdated before the call)
probes.failedTest: D-022 call-content policy > R-42: a notice cannot be backdated, future-dated, re-dated or forged by an upsert

probes.name: playout
probes.subject: worker/src/agent.ts
probes.mutation: `void handle.waitForPlayout()` replaced by `void Promise.resolve()` (notice reported to the sidecar before it finished playing)
probes.failedTest: ongoing worker authority (real entry and SidecarClient; media/provider doubles) > opens with the D-022 capture notice and reports it only after the notice has played

probes.name: deletion
probes.subject: packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts
probes.mutation: deleteCallContent: the `DELETE FROM phone_voicemails WHERE owner_id = ... AND call_id = ...` statement removed (voicemail content survives an authorized deletion)
probes.failedTest: call deletion (postgres) > atomically erases message/search content and retains one idempotent replay tombstone (+4 more)

probes.name: tenant
probes.subject: packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts
probes.mutation: listVoicemails (line 618 only): `WHERE owner_id = ${ownerId}` replaced by `WHERE true` (another tenant's voicemail becomes visible)
probes.failedTest: voicemail persistence (postgres) > keeps a read message read during concurrent worker replays (+2 more, including the cross-tenant isolation case)

probes.name: persist
probes.subject: packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts
probes.mutation: saveVoicemail: the inserted transcript `${voicemail.transcript}` replaced by '' (the stored voicemail is incomplete when read back)
probes.failedTest: voicemail persistence (postgres) > keeps a read message read during concurrent worker replays (+1 more)
